Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Anurag Vajpeyi,Prateek Dwivedi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused material on record.

The present application has been filed by the applicant with a prayer to issue direction to the court concerned to conclude the proceedings of complaint bearing Case No. 5624 of 2011 under Sections 7/16 The Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, Police Station Sector-20 Noida, District Gautam Budh Nagar, pending before Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-1, Gautam Budh Nagar.

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has no objection in this regard.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and submission made by learned counsel for applicant as well as learned A.G.A., it is expedient to direct the court concerned to make its endeavour to conclude the proceedings of the case in accordance with law within a period of one year, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, if there is no other legal impediment or any stay order from this Court or by the Hon'ble Apex Court.
With the aforesaid directions, the present application stands disposed of finally.
